draft_en.subject: Alongside the ORing switches and converters you carry - DIN managed PoE and gigabit converters
draft_en.body:
Hello Data Controls team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 29 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the ORing industrial switches and the media converters you carry for transport and energy networks, neutral packing, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $78.9 USD; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5; PoE version - STI-111GP - $27.8. A bypass unit (8 x PoE+ + 4 x SFP with hardware fibre bypass) is available on request. CWDM and rail-certified positions we do not quote. PSE-marked Mean Well adapters on the desktop units.

One question: which port count do your transport and energy customers order most - 4, 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
